Everything about your audience is generated by %1$s. No real people watch your lives, and viewer counts, comments, gifts and followers are not real engagement. Creators in the feed are fictional.

Camera frames are shown only on your screen. While you\'re live, each sentence you say is sent to our server, which turns it into text with a speech service (Groq) and asks an AI model (Google Gemini) to write the audience\'s comments. We don\'t store the audio or the text; the AI providers handle requests under their own terms. Your profile, live summaries and inbox are saved to your account so they follow you between devices; transcripts are not.
